mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_FIN_TRANSACTION (TX_ID, ACC_NO_ENC, AMOUNT, STATUS, BIZ_CODE, CREATED_AT) VALUES (#{txId}, #{accNoEnc}, #{amount}, #{status}, #{bizCode}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_FIN_TRANSACTION WHERE STATUS = 'PENDING'
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_FIN_TRANSACTION SET STATUS = 'SETTLED' WHERE STATUS = 'PENDING'
UPDATE TB_FIN_TRANSACTION SET STATUS = 'SETTLED' WHERE STATUS = 'PENDING' AND BIZ_CODE = #{bizCode}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_SETTLEMENT_LOG (JOB_ID, TARGET_DATE, PROCESSED_COUNT, STATUS, EXECUTED_AT) VALUES (#{jobId}, #{targetDate}, #{processedCount}, #{status}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
